what: Each headline figure this repository states, the exact sentence where it stands, how it is reproduced, and whether it can be reproduced from this repository. Checked fail-closed by research_grade.py.

claims.claim: On the hardened set, the best word-overlap threshold separates contradictions from controls at 75% (chance 50%).
claims.exact: The hardened set here caps a string-matcher at **75%** (chance is 50%)
claims.why_not: The case plaintexts are in sealed/, which is gitignored until a reveal. The preregistration (938938a) commits to per-statement SHA-256s, so a revealed set can be checked against it before re-running.
claims.limits: One 16-case set; the cap measures the set's surface solvability, not any model.

claims.claim: A 3B local model scored 3 hits and 0 false alarms of 8 each on the hardened set.
claims.exact: On the hardened set it scores 3/8 hits, 0/8 false alarms
claims.why_not: The recordings and grades are in sealed/, which is gitignored.
claims.limits: One small model, one run; a floor, not a comparison.

claims.claim: Against the hardened set, Grok Expert flagged all 8 contradictions; the control arm is exploratory.
claims.why_not: The recording and grades are sealed; the run was scored by hand, not through score.py.
claims.limits: One model, one blind scorer, one run. Two control-arm confounds; one mis-authored control voided. Record shown in context, so this tests reasoning, not autonomous detection.

claims.claim: The original 8-case run, re-scored through the fixed score.py, gives the same 3 hits and 0 false alarms.
claims.exact: re-scores to the same 3/3 hits and 0/5 false alarms
claims.why_not: The 8-case key and Tien's blind grades are in sealed/, which is gitignored.
claims.limits: Shows the scorer fix moved no published result; it is not a new measurement.

claims.claim: The scorer's both-ways tests run 25 checks with none failing.
claims.limits: Tests the scorer on synthetic keys and grades; says nothing about any model.
